attributes.name: Widow and Dearly Departed
attributes.powers:
During the check against Dearly Departed, this monster is immune to the Mental and Poison traits.

If defeated, you may immediately succeed at an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma check with a difficulty equal to the number of cards in the panic deck to close the location this henchman came from.

corrections.corrected_text: On the henchman Widow and Dearly Departed, replace the Human trait with the Half-Elf trait.
corrections.issue: That Widow sure has pointy ears for a human.
